# Overkill Entertainment — DJ Wolverine

Overkill Entertainment is Nairobi's elite event selector led by resident DJ Wolverine. Services: club nights, festivals, weddings, corporate events. Listen on HearThis (https://hearthis.at/dj-wolverine/) and Mixcloud (https://www.mixcloud.com/djwolverine_ke/). Apple Podcasts: DJ Wolverine Mixes. Book via website booking.

- Mixes: https://overkill-entertainment.scalingenterprises.workers.dev/#mixes
